description.subject: A hand-worked yarn figure of a small girl with a round ivory-coloured head, black bead eyes with painted lashes, and a small embroidered pink mouth.
description.covering: It wears a knitted crimson hooded dress with flared ruffled cuffs and a ruffled hem, tied at the throat with a looped drawstring, over pale leggings that reach the ankles, with brown rubber-style boots.
description.posture: It stands upright with arms hanging at its sides, its head and form turned toward the viewer.
description.setting: It stands outdoors on a bed of smooth rounded river stones in brown, tan and slate tones, in front of a slatted painted bench with green foliage behind.
description.light: Soft, diffuse daylight with no hard shadows, neutral to slightly warm in colour, falling from the front and above.
description.anomaly: Two round amber-coloured translucent beads hang from the ends of the drawstring at the hood's throat.
